architecture.note: The original 45 remain the canonical business/domain divisions. The additional 20 are cross-domain capability MasterBots so new products and capabilities always have a governed home without renaming the original divisions.

training_policy.goal: maximize measurable benchmark gap closure per available runner minute
training_policy.runner_policy: use legitimate GitHub-hosted capacity and plan concurrency; do not bypass quotas or manufacture work
